title: Da Nang in a day
summary: The Cham Museum in the morning, lunch on mi Quang, then My Khe. Son Tra or the Marble Mountains only if the day still has room.

stops.name: Museum of Cham Sculpture
stops.note: Start on the river, before the beach.

stops.name: Mi Quang
stops.note: Lunch. Toss the noodles. Do not expect a deep soup.

stops.name: My Khe Beach
stops.note: Ride from the river. Swim only if the flags allow it.

stops.name: Marble Mountains
stops.note: Optional, on the way toward Hoi An. Skip it if the beach used the afternoon.

seoDescription: A one-day Da Nang plan: the Cham Museum, mi Quang, and My Khe, with the Marble Mountains only if time remains.
